name: Zi Rui
source:
Ever since her mother left, she has refused to be close to people but is afraid of being alone. Often sitting alone and staring at her seat, she is unwilling to go out in her free time, until the cat she picked up on the road later turned into a mysterious catgirl.

[From [url=https://app.cngal.org/entries/index/4083]CnGal[/url]]
